title: Event
description: A parsed shutoff notice. POST /alert returns it and saves it as plans/(event_id)/event.json. It is also the input schema of the Bedrock tool record_event.

event_id.description: Event ID from the notice, for example PSPS-DEMO-01.

issued_at.description: When the utility issued the notice.

area_name.description: Area name exactly as written in the notice. Matches outage_area.geojson properties.event_area.

source_text.description: The full notice text as received.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 with an explicit offset, for example 2026-10-27T18:00:00-07:00.
